boundary: Read-only planning and engineering evidence. No transaction was built, signed, or submitted. Hosted DEX APIs were used only for candidate discovery; admitted addresses were independently bound through configured public RPC state. Liquidity values are observations, not guarantees.

sourcePacket.scope: Original factual records, RPC receipts, and source pointers; no SDK or protocol source copied.

orca.warning: Adaptive fees are observed state and are not emitted as a fixed rational runtime quote fee.

abiAndMath.formula: adjusted = amountIn * (feeDenominator - feeNumerator); amountOut = floor(adjusted * reserveOut / (reserveIn * feeDenominator + adjusted))
abiAndMath.bounds: All decimal quantities are strings; input and every Solidity-equivalent intermediate are <= uint256; reserves are strict uint112; output and reserves must be positive.
abiAndMath.sourceDeclaration: The formula and ABI encodings are independently written engineering logic. No protocol SDK, IDL, comments, or source implementation is copied.
